segments.title: Yokosuka as a naval town and museum stop
segments.summary: A museum near Yokosuka's naval base combines industrial-era displays with a wider impression of the city as a place shaped by its naval identity.
segments.body: A museum near Yokosuka's naval base makes the city's maritime identity immediately visible. Its displays include material on the industrial period, although this short update does not identify individual exhibits in the narration. The visit places local industrial history beside the continuing presence of the base. Yokosuka is described as a town where its connection to the navy can be felt throughout. This brief stop provides an orientation to the city before the group's planned return to Mikasa the following day.

evidence.note: The transcript places the museum by the naval base, mentions industrial-period displays, and describes Yokosuka as a navy town.
